title: kit.handwritten-ledger.v1
description: The canon checks' modules and what each is: the engine that runs declared contracts on canonical parsers, or a hand-written check frozen on the day hand-written checks stopped being permitted (2026-10-07), each with the work order that migrates it onto the engine. A module not listed fails; a hand-written entry frozen later fails; the ledger only shrinks.

scope.description: Directories whose every .js module must be declared here.

frozen_on.description: The day hand-written checks stopped being permitted: no hand-written entry may be frozen after it.

role.description: engine: runs declared contracts or is its plumbing; handwritten: a rule or parser written in code, frozen until migrated

parses.description: handwritten: what it reads by hand

migrate_to.description: handwritten: the canonical parser and contract kind it moves to
